rules: Show real shipped work in a natural, simple, professional voice.
Use a number-first opening only if the number is relevant to this topic and supported by the Story Bank; otherwise start with a concrete statement.
Keep the post concise when source facts are thin; do not pad it to a target length.
Use 1-2 sentence paragraphs separated by blank lines.
Avoid generic AI phrases, stacked three-part lists, "Stop X, start Y" framing, and excessive em dashes.
Do not inflate a technical fact into a broad claim.
